video.title: AI欧腐《落入教父掌心/Obsessed by the Mafia Boss's Grip》
video.desc:
Cast out by his family and drowning in self-loathing, young Finn is working at a convenience store when he is harassed—only to be saved by Lucian, the ruthless don of the Gallo crime family. Lucian has carried Finn in his heart ever since the boy saved his life years ago. With quiet tenderness and patience, he draws Finn close, helping him heal and accept himself. Drawn together across worlds of power and shame, the two move from tentative longing to deep love, saving each other in the process.
被家人扫地出门、深陷自我厌弃的 Finn，在便利店打工时遭人骚扰——救下他的，是 Gallo 犯罪家族冷酷无情的教父 Lucian。多年前，Finn 曾救过 Lucian 一命，从那以后，Lucian 便一直把他放在心上。他以无声的温柔与耐心，一点点将 Finn 拉近，帮他疗愈伤痛、接纳自己。两个来自权力与羞耻两端的人，就此走到一起，从试探的渴望走向深沉的爱，在这个过程中，彼此救赎。
